summary: Verified 3 reported bug fixes + Phase 2 (real file uploads, Discord bidirectional gateway wiring). Backend pytest phase-2 suite (5 tests) all pass. Frontend Playwright E2E on /soporte confirms: (1) real-time chat sends produce EXACTLY 1 bubble per send (sent 4, got 4, each text count=1) — triplication bug is fixed; (2) close/reopen buttons work end-to-end (input hides/returns, system messages 🔒 cerró / 🔓 reabrió appear); (3) server dropdown for report_player shows 'LA ISLA NUBLAR - X3 - SEMI-REALISMO - VC - ESP/LATAM'; (4) real file upload via [data-testid=upload-btn]/[data-testid=file-input] uploads a PNG, chip appears, sending renders inline that loads (naturalWidth>0) from /api/tickets/files/{id}.png; (5) staff panel toggle exposes all 7 queue boxes. Discord gateway starts on backend boot (log 'Discord gateway conectado como ASISTOSAURIO#6822'). Ticket creation was flaky in one run due to 12s per-user cooldown overlapping with pytest run — not a bug, expected behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: tickets.py _pub_ticket ignores is_staff flag — 'fields' dict (which may include steam_id / reported_player / evidence links) is always returned. Currently gated by _can_view/_can_manage in the endpoints, but the parameter is misleading; either drop it or actually strip staff-only fields for non-staff.

tickets.py serve_file endpoint /api/tickets/files/{fname} is fully PUBLIC (no auth). Uploaded evidence from private tickets (SteamIDs, reports, appeals) is world-readable by anyone who guesses the 32-hex id. Consider signed URLs with short-lived JWT tokens, or auth+ownership check inside serve_file. This is a privacy concern more than a security hole (ids are unguessable), but worth calling out.
tickets.py _create_cooldown is an unbounded in-memory dict without eviction — leaks over long uptimes. Add periodic prune or use TTL cache.
tickets.py TicketHub is process-local; multi-worker deployments will not broadcast typing/viewing/staff events across workers. Fine for uvicorn --workers 1, but document it.

Support.jsx TicketView.send: after the POST succeeds, it appends the returned message optimistically, but the WS 'message:new' event will also fire for the same message. Dedup by msg.id (implemented via .filter((x) => x.id !== r.message.id)) — good, but ensure that pattern is preserved on future refactors as it is the crux of the triplication fix.
Support.jsx WebSocket useEffect deps are [user?.id] — comment already explains this is intentional. Please keep the eslint-disable comment.

tickets.py upload_evidence: the PUBLIC_URL is optional; when unset the returned URL becomes '/api/tickets/files/<id>.png' (no origin), which currently works because the frontend calls it same-origin, but Discord relay would break. Consider raising if PUBLIC_URL is unset or falling back to request.base_url.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo -> JWT; localStorage.primal_token. Demo user is admin/staff.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all 3 reported bugs verified fixed. Triplication root cause (per code comment) was WebSocket useEffect depending on [user, mode], which reconnected on every mode/balance change and left stale sockets receiving+dispatching duplicate 'message:new' events. Fix: depend on [user?.id] only + dedup incoming messages by id in both the optimistic append and WS handler.
